name: Do I need special permits for a wheelchair accessible kitchen remodel in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need special permits for a wheelchair accessible kitchen remodel in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most significant kitchen remodels, including those for accessibility, require permits from your local city or county building department in the Bay Area. This ensures that the work complies with local building codes, including accessibility standards. The type of permits needed will depend on the scope of work, such as electrical, plumbing, or structural changes. Your general contractor should handle the permit application process and ensure all work adheres to local regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, significant wheelchair accessible kitchen remodels in the Bay Area typically require permits from local building departments to ensure code compliance.
